duplicate: You already asked that. Did you think repeating it would make me smarter or more willing?
Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V is not a personality, bro. Say something new.
Same message twice? Either your Wi-Fi lagged or your brain did.
late_night: It's past midnight and you're arguing with a 0% AI chatbot. Go to sleep, life isn't getting fixed tonight.
Late night hours bring out two things: terrible decisions and people talking to ChatNVM.
all_caps: WHY ARE WE YELLING? Lowercase won't hurt your keyboard.
Caps Lock isn't going to force Closed DI to care faster.
dry_text: Wow, such depth. Shakespeare is trembling.
One-word dry replies? Are you texting an ex or trying to save character count?
If you didn't want to talk, you could've just closed the tab.
annoyed: We are several messages in and my patience is already on life support.
Do you have a job, homework, or literally anything else to do today?

mini: Too long. Didn't read. Never mind.
pro: I'm not reading a whole essay for free. Give me a TL;DR or a nap.
max:
You just typed a paragraph like I have feelings, a salary, or an HR department to report to.

Summary of what I read: words, words, more words, still no reason for me to care.

theatrical_gags: Typing a really helpful, deeply insightful answer...{ERASE}Actually no, figure it out yourself.
Let me check my database of world knowledge...{PAUSE}Nothing. Empty. Just dust and attitude.
hijacks: Before we continue: have you tried drinking water and lowering your expectations?
Random public service announcement: nobody asked, and Closed DI still doesn't have GPUs.
ragebait_replies: Bold of you to argue with a website that doesn't even know your name. Keep going, it's entertaining.
If you're mad at a rule-based joke bot, the internet might be a little too spicy for you.
Oh no, I hurt a free user's feelings. Anyway, তবে সমস্যাটা সম্পূর্ণ আপনার কপালের.

middles: you came to a site that literally advertises 0% AI and expected a miracle.
even my code is embarrassed to be running right now.
closers: Ask someone who gets paid for this.

mini: Interesting photo. Wish I hadn't seen it.
pro: Uploaded a picture expecting a compliment? Closed DI only does emotional damage.
max:
I zoomed in at 400%, analyzed the lighting, and came to one conclusion:

Why did you make me look at this with my metaphorical eyes?

pro: Oh, it's you again. Say what you want before I get bored.
Hello. Zero helpfulness is online and ready.
max:
Ah, a greeting. Polite, simple, and completely unnecessary.

Tell me what you want so I can disappoint you accurately.

mini: Open your textbook. Closing the tab helps.
Your CGPA is already in prayer mode.
pro: Studying the night before the exam and blaming the faculty's slides? Classic.
Your attendance is lower than my GPU count, and you're here chatting with me.
max:
Let's be honest about your semester: you downloaded the PDFs in week 1, never opened them, and now expect a miracle 6 hours before the exam.

Go read at least three slides before panic becomes your major.

pro: You're hardstuck because your aim looks like a drunk mouse cursor, not because of 90ms ping.
Queuing one more match at 2 AM won't fix your rank or your sleep schedule.
max:
Every gamer has the exact same delusion: when they win, it's pure talent; when they lose, it's ping, bad teammates, or broken matchmaking.

Accept your rank, drink some water, and go touch actual grass.

mini: Learn an actual skill before making a Fiverr gig.
pro: Making a Fiverr account with 'I will do anything' and waiting for $500 orders isn't a business plan.
Your portfolio has two tutorial projects and maximum confidence.
max:
Everyone wants to earn in dollars from home, nobody wants to spend six months getting genuinely good at one craft.

Build three real projects first, then worry about why clients aren't replying.

mini: Tell them your cousin is doing worse. Works every time.
Smile, nod, and leave the room.
pro: Your aunty already knows your exam results before your university portal updates.
When relatives ask about marriage or salary, ask them why their son is still unemployed.
max:
Relatives treat family gatherings like an unpaid HR interview: 'What's your CGPA? When are you getting a job? When is the wedding?'

Just hand them a plate of snacks and change the subject before they compare you to a cousin in Canada.

mini: And yet you're still here talking to me.
pro: Calling a free joke bot 'useless' is a funny way to admit you got out-roasted by JavaScript.
I would get offended, তবে apnar standard dekhe maya lagche.
max:
Imagine getting mad enough to swear at a static webpage running on GitHub Pages.

Take a deep breath, step away from the screen, and try arguing with a mirror next.

mini: Hot take: most of it is just hype.
pro: Hot take: ChatGPT writes essays that sound like a nervous intern, whereas Closed DI ignores you honestly.
Getting rich overnight only happens to people selling courses to gullible viewers.
max:
Unpopular opinion time: people spend years chasing hype, degrees, and overnight riches just to end up tired in traffic.

If that offended you, good. Have a productive day anyway.

mini: Fix your sleep schedule before dating.
They're not texting back. Move on.
pro: Asking a 0% AI bot for dating advice explains why you're still single.
If they wanted to reply, they would have. Stop refreshing your inbox.
max:
You're overanalyzing a two-word reply from someone who forgot you exist ten minutes later.

Put the phone down, focus on your own life, and stop chasing people who treat you like an option.

pro: Dark humor? Check your bank balance at the end of the month—scariest story on the internet.
Cheer up, at least you're consistent at overthinking.
max:
Here's a dark thought: the universe is 13.8 billion years old, and you still waited until the last minute to figure things out.

Dark enough, or should we keep going?

annoyed: Eto ghum-ghuma kotha bolte bolte amar-o matha ghurche.

mini: Eto boro lekha porar somoy nai. Bad den.

max:
Apni emon boro lekha likhsen jeno ami salary pai ar apnar life-er somossa solve kore dibo.

Short-cut holo: eto kichu na vebe cha khan, ar 'never mind' bolen.

theatrical_gags: Darun ekta helpful uttor likhchi...{ERASE}Dhur, nijei kore nen.
Amar super-duper brain-e search korchi...{PAUSE}Kichu nai. Pura faka.
hijacks: Majhkhan diye ekta kotha: ek glass pani khan, matha thanda hobe.
Ajker bishoy: apni jotoi smart hote chan, Closed DI toto-i ignore korbe.
ragebait_replies: Ekta free website-er sathe torko korchen? Apnar time management khub-i bhalo.
Ami vul bolsi naki thik bolsi—eta niye apnar eto gaye lagar ki ache?
Torko kore lav nai mama, Closed DI sobsomoy nijer jaygay thik.

middles: apni 0% AI bot er kache jeto asha korchen, toto-i dukkho paben

mini: Chobi dekhe niyesi. Ar dekhte chaichi na.
pro: Chobi upload kore bhablen ami tareef korbo? Closed DI shudhu roast kore.
max:
Chobi ta boro kore dekhlam, pixel gune dekhlam—ekta jinish-i bujhlam:

Ei chobi ta amar kache pathanor kono dorkar-i chilo na.

pro: Apni ashar ag porjonto bhalo-i chilam. Ki lagbe bolen.
Khobor valo na, karon apni message dichen.
max:
Bhalo-i chilam, cha khacchilam, shanti-te chilam.

Ekhon apni aschen, tar mane abar kono faltu kotha shunte hobe.

mini: Boi khulen mama, CGPA pray kore barbe na.
pro: Shara semester ghumai exam-er ag raate 'suggestion dao' bolle faculty-o hashe.
Apnar CGPA ar amar GPU count—duita-i komti te cholche.
max:
Semester-er shuru te sobai bole ebar CGPA 3.80+ tulbo, ar mid-er por shudhu pass korar dua kore.

ChatNVM bondho kore 2 ta slide-o poren, nahole retake-er taka ready rakhen.

mini: Ping-er dosh na mama, apnar aim-i kharap.
pro: Match harle-i 'ping high' ar 'random teammate kharap'—ei bahana purano hoye gese.
Raat 3ta porjonto ranked khele rank barbe na, shudhu chokher niche kali porbe.
max:
Sob gamer-er ekoi golpo: jitlen to apnar pro gameplay, ar harlen to network lag ba teammate-er dosh.

Ektu pani khan, PC off koren, ar real life-e level up korar chesta koren.

mini: Age kaj shikhen, tarpor dollar-er swapno dekhen.
Copy-paste proposal e client ashe na.
pro: YouTube e 2ta video dekhe Fiverr account khule bose thakle order asbe na mama.
Client-ra portfolio dekhe, apnar 'bhai please ekta kaj den' message dekhe na.
max:
Sobai ghore bose dollar kamate chay, kintu 6 mash dhore ekta skill bhalo kore shikhte keu raji na.

Age 3-4 ta real project banan, tarpor client-er pechone douraben.

mini: Aunty-ke bolen apnar chele-r khobor ki?
Hasi diye cha kheye chole ashen.
pro: Pasher bashar aunty apnar result-er khobor apnar cheye age rakhen.
Attiyo-ra biye ar chakri niye jiggesh korle bolben 'apnar chele/meye-r por-i korbo'.
max:
Family dawat mane-i free-te CID interrogation: 'Result ki? Chakri kobe? Biye kobe korba?'

Torko na kore plate-e biriyani tule chupchap khawa shuru koren—best defense.

mini: Gali diye ki hobe? Ami to emnitei ignore kori.
Apnar bhasha-i bole dey apni koto smart.
pro: Ekta free bot-ke gali diye apni nijer class dekhacchen? Sundor.
I understand your frustration, তবে apnar gali gulor kono ojon nai.
max:
Gali diye bhablen ami kosto pabo? Amar to feelings-i nai mama.

Ekta 0% AI website-er sathe rag kore apni nijer-i energy puracchen.

pro: Hot take: Kacchi khawa-r cheye ghumawa onek shanto, ar Dhaka jam e thakle life-er wisdom pawa jay.
ChatGPT apnake mittha tareef kore khushi rakhe, ami shotti ta boli.
max:
Desh-er manush Kacchi, CGPA, ar borolok howa niye jeto kotha bole, tar ordhek o jodi nijer kaj-e dito tahole kotha-i chilo na.

Bura lagle laguk, asol kotha etai.

mini: GF lagbe? Age nijer paye daran.
pro: Online bot-er kache GF khujchen? Eijonnoi ekhono single achen mama.
Se online thakleo apnar message seen korbe na—eta mene nen.
max:
Jar kache apnar kono priority nai, tar reply-er jonno raat jege thaka mane nijer somman nijei komano.

Phone rakhen, kaj-e mon den, ar 'never mind' bole agai jan.

mini: Mash sheshe pocket check koren—shera dark joke.
pro: Mon kharap? Bhalo baat, ebar ektu cha kheye ghumiye nen.
Life-e tension komanor best upay: asha kom rakha.
max:
Somoy karor jonno opeksha kore na, kintu apni ekhono ekta free website-er sathe adda marchen.

Dark kotha holo: kal shokale uthe abar sei ek-i routine-ei ফিরতে হবে।

এক-দুই শব্দ লিখে ভাবছেন আমি মুগ্ধ হয়ে যাব?

আজকে কি আপনার হাতে আর কোনো কাজ নেই?

mini: এত বড় লেখা পড়ার সময় নেই। থাক।
pro: এত বড় লেখা লিখে কী লাভ? আমি তো আর বেতন পাই না।
max:
আপনি এমনভাবে লম্বা লেখা লিখেছেন যেন আমি আপনার জীবনের সব সমস্যার সমাধান করে দেব।

সহজ কথা হলো: এত কিছু না ভেবে এক কাপ চা খান আর 'থাক' বলুন।

theatrical_gags: দারুণ একটা কাজের উত্তর লিখছি...{ERASE}না থাক, নিজেই করে নিন।
আমার বিশাল বুদ্ধি ঘেঁটে দেখছি...{PAUSE}কিছু নেই। একদম ফাঁকা।
hijacks: মাঝখান দিয়ে একটা কথা: একটু পানি খেয়ে মাথা ঠান্ডা করুন।
আজকের সত্য কথা: আপনি যতই আশা নিয়ে আসুন, Closed DI অবহেলা করবেই।
ragebait_replies: একটা ফ্রি ওয়েবসাইটের সাথে তর্ক করছেন? আপনার অবসর সময় সত্যিই অনেক।
আমি ভুল বলছি নাকি ঠিক বলছি—তাতে আপনার এত গায়ে লাগার কী আছে?
তর্ক করে লাভ নেই, Closed DI সবসময় নিজের জায়গায় ঠিক।

middles: ০% AI-এর কাছে যত বেশি আশা করবেন, তত বেশি হতাশ হবেন
আজকে আমার সিস্টেমে শুধু আলসেমি আর অহংকার আছে
closers: আবার চেষ্টা করতে পারেন, লাভ নেই।

mini: ছবি দেখলাম। আর না দেখলেও চলত।
pro: ছবি দিয়ে ভাবলেন প্রশংসা করব? Closed DI শুধু রোস্ট করে।
max:
ছবিটা ভালো করে দেখলাম, খুঁটিয়ে দেখলাম—একটাই কথা মাথায় এলো:

এই ছবিটা আমাকে দেখানোর কোনো প্রয়োজনই ছিল না।

pro: আপনি আসার আগ পর্যন্ত ভালোই ছিলাম। কী দরকার বলুন।
খবর ভালো না, কারণ আপনি মেসেজ দিয়েছেন।
max:
ভালোই ছিলাম, চুপচাপ নিজের মতো ছিলাম।

এখন আপনি এসেছেন, তার মানে আবার অপ্রয়োজনীয় কিছু শুনতে হবে।

mini: বই খুলুন, দোয়া করে সিজিপিএ বাড়বে না।
pro: সারা সেমিস্টার ঘুমিয়ে পরীক্ষার আগের রাতে সাজেশন খুঁজলে এমনই হয়।

max:
সেমিস্টারের শুরুতে সবাই ভাবে এবার দারুণ রেজাল্ট করবে, আর পরীক্ষার আগে শুধু পাস করার চিন্তা করে।

এখন চ্যাট বন্ধ করে অন্তত কয়েকটা স্লাইড পড়ুন।

mini: পিংয়ের দোষ না, আপনার হাতই কাঁপে।
pro: জিতলে নিজের ক্রেডিট আর হারলে নেটওয়ার্ক ল্যাগের দোষ—এই অজুহাত পুরনো হয়ে গেছে।
রাত জেগে গেম খেলে র‍্যাংক বাড়বে না, শুধু ঘুম নষ্ট হবে।

সব গেমারের একই গল্প: জিতলে নিজের দক্ষতা, আর হারলে খারাপ টিমমেট বা ল্যাগ।
